candidates.reason: Best of the set: ICE RINK headline is large and reads clearly, the promo row and LINK IN BIO pill are legible and grouped. But the skates are cropped hard at the top, so the hanging laces that carry the concept are lost. The arrow starts on the skate blade and crowds it. The bottom row is tight against the edge circles, and the skate illustration overpowers the upper half.

The headline shrank to secondary weight, so the skates dominate and the hierarchy is weak. The arrow is squeezed into the gap between the blade and the headline. In the promo row, XMASRINK and 50% OFF crowd the divider. A decorative circle jams against TO GET A DISCOUNT at the right edge, and the spacing is cramped overall.

The promo text (USE CODE / TO GET A DISCOUNT / 50% OFF) is shrunk to illegible micro-type, and the LINK IN BIO CTA is a tiny pill that is easy to miss. The lower third is mostly dead space with scattered circles. The headline sits too close under the blade, and the layout reads as a shrunk copy rather than a rearranged design.
